piece_knight: This is the knight! It jumps in an L shape.
piece_bishop: This is the bishop! It moves diagonally.
piece_rook: This is the rook! It moves in straight lines.
piece_queen: This is the queen! She is the most powerful piece.
piece_king: This is the king! Protect him at all costs.
board_intro: This is the chess board. It has light and dark squares.
pawn_moves: The pawn moves forward one square.
pawn_first_move: On its first move, the pawn can move two squares.
knight_moves: The knight jumps in an L shape. Two squares one way, then one to the side.
bishop_moves: The bishop slides diagonally as far as it wants.
rook_moves: The rook moves in straight lines, up, down, left, or right.
queen_moves: The queen combines the bishop and the rook. She can move in any direction!
king_moves: The king moves one square in any direction.
castling_intro: This is a special move called castling.
en_passant_intro: This is a special capture called en passant.
promotion_intro: When a pawn reaches the other side, it becomes a queen!
check_intro: Check means the king is under attack!
checkmate_intro: Checkmate! The king cannot escape. Game over!
fork_intro: A fork attacks two pieces at once!
pin_intro: A pin traps a piece because it shields the king.
